scope: replay stream queues, codecs, message payloads, and recovered in-memory layouts

applied.name: ReplayQueues_AppendVoiceStream
applied.evidence: Channel-3 dispatch wrapper clones a VoiceStreamData object into its dedicated replay queue.

applied.name: ReplayQueues_AppendTelestratorStream
applied.evidence: Channel-4 dispatch wrapper clones a TelestratorStreamData object into its dedicated replay queue.

applied.name: ReplayQueues_AppendMetadataStream
applied.evidence: Channels 0xFD..0xFF dispatch wrapper clones a MetaStreamData object into the metadata replay queue.

applied.name: ReplayQueues_AppendCameraStream
applied.evidence: Channel-2 dispatch wrapper clones a CameraStreamData object into its dedicated replay queue.

applied.name: ReplayObjectStreamData_Save
applied.evidence: Shared Camera/Voice/Telestrator writer emits a u16 object count and then each stream ID plus serialized NetCommandMsg envelope.

applied.name: ReplayObjectStreamData_Load
applied.evidence: Shared Camera/Voice/Telestrator loader reads the object count, deserializes NetCommandMsg envelopes, and appends references.

applied.name: MetaStreamData_Save
applied.evidence: Writes u8 count followed by count raw 60-byte BroadcastMetadata objects.

applied.name: MetaStreamData_Load
applied.evidence: Validates 1 + count*60 against payload size and copies each BroadcastMetadata object.

applied.name: GameCommandStreamData_Save
applied.evidence: Channel-1 writer serializes the counted vector of 132-byte GameMessage objects through GameCommandStreamData_XferMessages.

applied.name: NetCameraDataMsg_DebugFormat
applied.evidence: Formats CAMERA frame, optional pos, and optional rot fields; strings and offsets independently establish the role.

applied.name: NetCameraDataMsg_Xfer
applied.evidence: Xfers frame and update flags, followed by optional Coord3D position and four-float rotation selected by flag bits 1 and 2.

applied.name: NetTelestratorDataMsg_DebugFormat
applied.evidence: Formats TELESTRATOR frame and byte count; literal strings and field offsets independently establish the role.

applied.name: NetTelestratorDataMsg_Xfer
applied.evidence: Xfers u32 frame, u8 data size, allocates on load, and transfers the drawing byte payload.

applied.name: NetVoiceDataMsg_DebugFormat
applied.evidence: Formats VOICE frame, byte count, and serial; literal strings and field offsets independently establish the role.

applied.name: NetVoiceDataMsg_Xfer
applied.evidence: Xfers u32 frame, u16 serial, u16 data size, allocates on load, and transfers the voice byte payload.
